# National Centre for Social Research

> Britain's largest independent not-for-profit social research organisation generating evidence on UK society through complex surveys, longitudinal studies, and policy research since 1969.

NatCen conducts rigorous social research across the UK and internationally, operating flagship surveys like British Social Attitudes and the English Housing Survey while maintaining regional operations through ScotCen in Scotland. The organisation serves government, charities, businesses, and universities to inform evidence-based policy and public understanding.

## Centres & Operations

- [Centres of excellence](https://natcen.ac.uk/what-we-do/centres-excellence): NatCen's centres of excellence in policy, methodology and research specialisms

- [NatCen International](https://natcen.ac.uk/international): NatCen International empowering societies through global social research
- [NatCen Opinion Panel](https://natcen.ac.uk/centres/natcen-panel): NatCen Opinion Panel: Britain's longest-running probability-based panel
